NONE: B1 to hold someone close to your body with your arms, usually to show that you like, love, or value them
擁抱，摟抱（以示喜歡或欣賞）
B1 the act of holding someone or something close to your body with your arms
› to stay very close to something or someone
› literary to keep something that makes you feel better or pleases you private or secret

example: Have you hugged your child today?
你今天擁抱過你的孩子沒有？
They hugged each other when they met at the station.
他們在車站碰面時互相擁抱。
Emily hugged her teddy bear tightly to her chest.
艾蜜莉把她的泰迪熊緊緊抱在胸前。
She sat on the floor hugging her knees (= with her knees bent up against her chest and her arms around them).
她雙手抱膝坐在地上。
Whenever I travel in the city I make sure I hug my handbag tightly to me.
每次我乘車穿過城區時，一定會把手袋緊緊抱著。
The road hugs the coast for several miles, then turns inland.
那條路有幾英哩緊臨海岸，然後轉向內陸。
This type of car will hug (= not slide on) the road, even in the wettest conditions.
即使在最濕滑的情況下，這種汽車也不會在路面上打滑。
a figure-hugging dress
緊身衣
I hugged the idea to myself all through dinner.
整個晚餐我都在暗自盤算這個主意。
Come here and give me a big hug.
過來好好抱我一下。
We always exchange hugs and kisses when we meet.
我們見面時總是互相擁抱和親吻。

NONE: B1 extremely large in size or amount

example: They live in a huge house.
他們住在一棟很大的房子裡。
The costs involved in building a spacecraft are huge.
建造一艘太空船的費用很高。
A huge number of people attended.
參加者為數眾多。
His last three movies have all been huge successes.
他最後的三部電影都獲得了空前的成功。
He gave her a hugely expensive diamond ring.
他送給她一枚十分昂貴的鑽戒。
Their business has been hugely successful.
他們的生意極為成功。
Synonym
extremely

NONE: › Someone or something that is huggable makes you want to hug him, her, or it.

example: He's so huggable!
我好想抱抱他！
